claims.label: YAP1-associated canthin-6-one tolerance in experimental yeast
claims.note: Conditional gene associations from one study, not two independent studies or resistance inferred from gene presence. G175-W303, BY4742 / EUROSCARF Y10000 and YPH250 are distinct laboratory backgrounds, not one experimental strain. YCF1 was a negative comparison. These findings do not establish a direct drug target or direct transport of canthin-6-one. No MIC or clinical resistance category inferred. Impaired growth without drug complicates the YAP1-loss sensitivity comparison. Reference-only S288c mapping: UniProtKB:P19880 (YAP1, YML007W; NCBITaxon:559292), not an experimental allele or protein assignment.

claims.label: FLR1-associated canthin-6-one tolerance in experimental yeast
claims.note: Conditional gene associations from one study, not two independent studies or resistance inferred from gene presence. G175-W303, BY4742 / EUROSCARF Y10000 and YPH250 are distinct laboratory backgrounds, not one experimental strain. YCF1 was a negative comparison. These findings do not establish a direct drug target or direct transport of canthin-6-one. No MIC or clinical resistance category inferred. The basal FLR1-loss comparison did not increase sensitivity in the tested context. Table 1 gives FLR1 locus YBR008C, whereas Table 2 prints YRR008C; no new alias is inferred from this discordance. Reference-only S288c mapping: UniProtKB:P38124 (FLR1, YBR008C; NCBITaxon:559292), not an experimental allele or protein assignment.
